title: Best gifts for 10-year-olds 2026 UK: LEGO, games and gadgets
seoTitle: Best Gifts for 10-Year-Olds 2026 UK: Picks from £15
description: Gift ideas for 10-year-olds at Black Friday prices: LEGO Technic Ferrari £34.99, Ticket to Ride £28.49, Instax Mini 12 £66.05 and Kindle Kids £89.99.
intro:
**The best all-round gift for a 10-year-old this Christmas is the LEGO Harry Potter Chomping Monster Book of Monsters (76449) at £41.99 on Amazon: a proper 9+ build that snaps its jaws when you open it. Best cheap pick: Herd Mentality at £15 from Argos. Best splurge: LEGO Hogwarts Castle: The Main Tower (76454) at £159.99 on Amazon, about £70 under Argos and Hamleys.**

Every price below comes from PriceSpy UK's shop listings on 24 November 2026, during Black Friday Week, with other UK shops for comparison. Prices are changing daily until Cyber Monday (30 November), so check the product page before you buy.

deals.name: Big Potato Herd Mentality party game
deals.note: Best cheap pick: everyone writes an answer and tries to match the herd. Rated 10+, quick to learn and good with grandparents. It has been under £10 in the last three months, so £15 is fair rather than a record.

deals.name: Ticket to Ride: Europe board game
deals.note: A modern classic for ages 8+: collect cards, claim train routes across Europe. Amazon is the cheapest of eight shops PriceSpy tracks; it has dipped to about £24 before.

deals.note: The newest Tamagotchi, with a zoom dial to look after pets on land, sea and sky. £30 is the lowest PriceSpy has seen in three months; Amazon is £42.99.

deals.name: LEGO Technic Ferrari FXX K (42212)
deals.note: A first proper Technic supercar, rated 10+, with working steering and a moving engine. Its lowest price in three months; Argos and Hamleys charge about £55.

deals.name: LEGO Harry Potter Chomping Monster Book of Monsters (76449)
deals.note: Best overall: a 9+ build of Hagrid's biting book that opens to reveal a small scene inside. Argos is £42 and Very £43.99. It has been £35 on eBay, but Amazon is the cheapest big shop.

deals.name: JBL Junior 470NC wireless kids' headphones (pink)
deals.note: Noise-cancelling headphones with volume limited to safer levels, ideal for car journeys and tablets. Currys is £49.99. Other colours vary in price, so check the colour before you buy.

deals.name: LEGO Minecraft The Pillager Outpost and Ravager (21278)
deals.note: For Minecraft fans, rated 9+: a tall outpost and a Ravager with a rider. Very matches; Hamleys and Currys charge £74.99. It has been about £4 cheaper this autumn.

deals.name: LEGO Harry Potter Book Nook: Hogwarts Express (76450)
deals.note: A 10+ build that slots between books on a shelf, with Platform 9¾ and the train. Very matches and Argos is £90, but it has been £47.99 in the last three months.

deals.name: Fujifilm Instax Mini 12 instant camera (Clay White)
deals.note: Point, shoot and the photo prints in seconds. Simple enough for a 10-year-old and great for sleepovers. Currys is £69.99. Budget around £1 a shot for film.

deals.name: Amazon Kindle Kids (2024, 16GB, Ocean Explorer)
deals.note: A glare-free e-reader with a kids' cover, a two-year worry-free guarantee and a year of Amazon Kids+ books. Argos matches. Make sure it's the 2024 model; the 2026 version costs £119.99.

deals.name: LEGO Harry Potter Hogwarts Castle: The Main Tower (76454)
deals.note: Best splurge: a big 10+ castle build for a child who loves Harry Potter. Very is £160, Argos £230 and Hamleys £229.99. It has been about £138, so it's a good price, not a record.

body:
## Best gifts for 10-year-olds at a glance

- **Best overall:** LEGO Harry Potter Chomping Monster Book of Monsters (76449), £41.99 at Amazon.
- **Best cheap:** Herd Mentality, £15 at Argos.
- **Best gadget:** Fujifilm Instax Mini 12, £66.05 at Amazon.
- **Best for readers:** Kindle Kids (2024), £89.99 at Amazon.
- **Best splurge:** LEGO Hogwarts Castle: The Main Tower (76454), £159.99 at Amazon.

## How to choose a gift for a 10-year-old

Ten is an in-between age. Most 10-year-olds still play, but they want things that feel grown-up, so anything that looks like it's for little kids tends to get left in the box. Three things work well:

- **Bigger builds.** LEGO sets rated 9+ or 10+ take an afternoon or two and end up on a shelf. Technic cars suit children who like seeing how things work; Harry Potter and Minecraft sets suit fans. Sets rated 18+ are display models aimed at adults and can be frustrating at this age.
- **Games the whole family can play.** Ten is when proper board games start to click. Ticket to Ride is easy to learn but has real decisions in it, and Herd Mentality is a party game that works across the generations on Christmas Day.
- **Their own gadget.** An instant camera, a Kindle or their own headphones feel like a step up. If you're buying headphones, choose a kids' pair that limits the volume, like the JBL Junior 470NC.

If you don't know the child well, ask the parents what they're into right now. A £30 set from the right film beats a £100 set from the wrong one.

## Good prices to aim for

These come from PriceSpy's three-month price history this week:

- **LEGO Technic Ferrari FXX K (42212):** £35 is its lowest. Anything under £40 is good.
- **LEGO Monster Book of Monsters (76449):** around £40 to £42 at the big shops.
- **LEGO Minecraft Pillager Outpost (21278):** under £57 is good; it has touched £52.99.
- **LEGO Book Nook Hogwarts Express (76450):** it has been under £50, so £63 is only worth paying if you can't wait.
- **LEGO Hogwarts Main Tower (76454):** £160 is good; about £138 would be excellent.
- **Kindle Kids (2024):** under £90 is a strong price.

Most toy prices hold until Cyber Monday on 30 November. After that, popular LEGO sets can sell out or creep back up in December, so buy the main present this week. If you're using Amazon close to Christmas, a [Prime free trial](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) gives you free fast delivery on eligible items.

## A gift for a 10-year-old who loves stories

If the child has a Kindle or a tablet, audiobooks are a good extra. Audible's Black Friday offer is £0.99 a month for three months until 17 December, and the Harry Potter and Percy Jackson audiobooks are favourites at this age. See our [Audible free trial guide](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/) for how it works and how to cancel.

For younger children, see our [best toys for 8-year-olds](/guides/best-toys-for-8-year-olds-2026/). For older ones, try our [gifts for teenage boys](/guides/gifts-for-teenage-boys-2026/) and [gifts for teenage girls](/guides/gifts-for-teenage-girls-2026/), or browse all our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/).

## FAQs

### What is a good Christmas present for a 10-year-old?

Something that feels a bit grown-up: a LEGO set rated 9+ or 10+, a family board game, an instant camera, a Kindle or a pair of kids' headphones. Our top pick is the LEGO Harry Potter Chomping Monster Book of Monsters at £41.99.

### How much should you spend on a 10-year-old's Christmas present?

Whatever suits your budget. A £15 game can get more use than a £60 set. If you're a relative or friend, £15 to £40 is typical; the parents usually buy the big present, so check with them first so nothing is doubled up.

### What LEGO is best for a 10-year-old?

Sets rated 9+ or 10+, such as Technic cars, Harry Potter and Minecraft. They're challenging without being frustrating. The Technic Ferrari FXX K at £34.99 is a good first Technic set.

### Is a Kindle a good gift for a 10-year-old?

Yes, for a child who already enjoys reading. The Kindle Kids has no apps or games to distract them, comes with a kids' cover and a two-year guarantee, and includes a year of Amazon Kids+ books.

### Is Herd Mentality OK for a 10-year-old?

Yes. It's rated 10+ and the questions are family-friendly. It's at its best with six or more players, which makes it a good Christmas Day game.
